name: [1-2 PLAYER OBBY] Push the Patient
desc:
Push a rolling hospital bed out of the hospital, patient included, through a chaotic obby of pills, rails and huge drops. He has no idea where you're taking him.

2-PLAYER DUO MODE!
Grab a friend: one pushes and brakes, the other lies in the bed and steers. Scream together, crash together, swap places anytime.

Can you get him there in one piece?

llm.loop: push a rolling hospital bed with a patient through obby stages -> avoid drops and obstacles -> reach the end of each level
llm.objectives: get the patient through the obby to the destination in one piece
llm.instructions: push the bed out of the hospital through pills, rails and drops; in duo mode one player pushes/brakes and the other lies in the bed and steers, swap anytime
unique: asymmetric duo co-op: one pushes, one rides and steers a hospital bed
llm.thumbnails: icon and one thumbnail of a noob patient screaming on a hospital bed on a green floating obby path with a hospital behind
llm.complexity_notes: linear obby course, bed physics/steering, two-player seat roles; simple UI
